I initially wrote that comment on the server, but I'll also put it here :

```

It's a great system,  but honestly, I don't think it's a good idea to add LV support, since it is a system that is still evolving. For instance, version 2 added point light volume support, which is incompatible with shaders that still uses version 1. If one day version 3+ gets released, all shaders might need to be updated again to support all the newly added features.

I believe those assets should have really simple shaders, and maybe have two variants like Standard/PBR and Toon shaded, that's it.

```

details:
# Issue:

Currently, the "Looks" section of the Avatar Main Menu as well as the Action Menu show all the looks that you have created for all of your Avatars.

While this is ideal for quickly glancing at your different looks, it can get quite cluttered and unorganised quickly when you have multiple skins.

The action menu for example will also only show you your first 9 looks.

# Suggestion / Feedback:

The "Looks" section of the Avatar Main Menu as well as the Action Menu should always only show the looks that you have created for the Avatar you are using right now.

This would make it a lot easier to find your different looks for your current Avatar in these menus and would prevent clutter from when you have too many looks.

To make this easier to understand for the general audience, you could also rename the "Looks" header in the Avatars Main Menu to "Looks for {Avatar Name}".
title: Looks should be shown per Avatar

comments.value: I think it makes sense to have a list of all looks in the main menu, but the action menu should only include looks for the current one. That way you have the best of both worlds, a global view of all looks and a quick way to switch between them for the current avi.

@{6051ea3c0127dc2014c112f0|full_name} That would also be okay, but I still think something to better organise looks in the Main Menu would be needed. It can still quite quickly become an unorganised mess.

details:
# Issue:

Currently, getting back to the default look of your Avatar is quite complicated, as you have to:

1. Switch to a different Avatar

2. Switch back to your original Avatar

While selecting your current Avatar in the Avatars Menu shows "Avatar changed to {Avatar Name}", but nothing actually happens.

# Suggestion:

Add a "Default Look" look to the beginning the "Looks" section of the Avatar Main Menu as well as the Action Menu. This would allow users to easily switch back to their default look without first having to figure out how to do that.
title: Make it easier to switch to the default look

comments.mergedPostDetails: This may not have been implemented yet, but currently you cant select which looks go in your quick menu. I'm pretty sure its just the first 9 that get put in there.

Selecting looks in the Main menu feels the same as selecting an avatar from your own, or from favorites. Its just a new button to select what avatar you want.

For the action menu look quick select it feels like a expression toggle. So just like you were able to quickly apply a look it feels like you should have a way to also quickly turn off that look. 

Some ideas that come to mind. 

1. Having a indicator to show what look is active just like an avatar toggle. clicking it again could switch back to previous avatar or the base avatar the look uses.

2. Have an additional button that you can click that revers back like the previous example.

3. Change it to a avatar select menu that you can customize. could put personal, or favorite avatars in there to quickly select them. instead of only looks.

details:
# Issue:

Currently, you can only fully reset an accessory, which resets everything:

- X,Y,Z Position

- X,Y,Z Rotation

- X,Y,Z Scale

- Custom Settings, e.g. Color

This makes it really annoying if you e.g. by accident move and accessory on the wrong axis which makes off centre.

# Suggestion:

Add a little "reset arrow" button to the X, Y and Z labels of each slider for position, rotation and scale, to allow us to reset each axis individually.

# Attachments:

Here is a very bad mock-up on what this could look like :D
title: Allow easily resetting position, rotation and scale for each axsis indepenendtly
